#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <algorithm>
#include <string>
#include <sstream>

using namespace std;

struct Node {
    int ind;
    long long val;
    Node(int i, long long v) : ind(i), val(v) {}
};

int gcd(int a, int b) {
    while (b != 0) {
        int temp = b;
        b = a % b;
        a = temp;
    }
    return a;
}

int binarySearch(const vector<long long>& list, long long val, int start) {
    int left = start, right = (int)list.size() - 1;
    int res = list.size();

    while (left <= right) {
        int mid = (left + right) / 2;
        if (list[mid] > val) {
            if (mid == 0) return mid;
            if (list[mid - 1] <= val) return mid;
            right = mid - 1;
        } else {
            left = mid + 1;
        }
    }
    return res;
}

long long recursive(vector<Node>& nodes, vector<long long>& b, int idx) {
    if (idx == 3) return 0;

    Node& node = nodes[idx];
    int bIdx = node.ind - 1;
    if (bIdx == -1) bIdx = 2;

    long long minA = min(node.val, b[bIdx]);
    node.val -= minA;
    b[bIdx] -= minA;

    long long minB = min(node.val, b[node.ind]);
    node.val -= minB;
    b[node.ind] -= minB;

    long long resA = node.val + recursive(nodes, b, idx + 1);
    node.val += minA + minB;
    b[bIdx] += minA;
    b[node.ind] += minB;

    // second scenario
    node = nodes[idx];
    bIdx = node.ind - 1;
    if (bIdx == -1) bIdx = 2;

    long long minC = min(node.val, b[node.ind]);
    node.val -= minC;
    b[node.ind] -= minC;

    long long minD = min(node.val, b[bIdx]);
    node.val -= minD;
    b[bIdx] -= minD;

    long long resB = node.val + recursive(nodes, b, idx + 1);
    node.val += minC + minD;
    b[bIdx] += minD;
    b[node.ind] += minC;

    return min(resA, resB);
}

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    int t = 1;
    while (t-- > 0) {
        int n;
        cin >> n;
        vector<long long> a(3), b(3);
        for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
            cin >> a[i];
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
            cin >> b[i];
        }

        long long maxVal = min(a[0], b[1]) + min(a[1], b[2]) + min(a[2], b[0]);
        long long minVal = max(0LL, a[0] + b[1] - n) + max(0LL, a[1] + b[2] - n) + max(0LL, a[2] + b[0] - n);
        cout << minVal << " " << maxVal << "\n";
    }
    return 0;
}
